title: Stable self-similar blowup for a supercritical defocusing Schrödinger equation on the torus

issues.description: Not an error, a note on scale. The core construction needs h_b^{1/a} ≤ 0.3, while h_b = 1 - O(1e-8 · ε-scale), with ε = 1e-4 and 1-h_b ≈ 1.5–2e-9. This forces a ≲ 1e-9, so the odd power p is of order 1e9. The theorem only claims 'sufficiently large p', so this is consistent. Readers should not expect a moderate p.
issues.evidence: From the bound in eq. (profile:boundary-gap), 1-.2ε² < h_b < 1-.15ε², the requirement h_b^{1/a} ≤ .3 gives 1/a ≥ ln(10/3)/(1.5e-9).

issues.description: The zero counts and the profile-matching degree depend on exact rational certificates. Their analytic reductions are in the text. I re-ran the verifier and checked the key outputs independently, and all agree. This is recorded only as a dependency, not a gap.
issues.evidence: exact_verifier.py run with python3 -I: output matches RESULTS.json. Independent mpmath checks: j(b*,Z*) ≈ -1.1e-16. ∂_b j ≈ -.0811+.1362i and ∂_Z j ≈ .1238i, matching the enclosures and giving negative determinant, so degree -1. Re j ≤ ~.032 < .043 on z ≥ Z, and Im j > 0 for z ≥ 3. Argument-principle zero counts of Δ_ℓ on Re λ ≥ -1/32 are 2,1,0,0,0 for ℓ = 0..4. Δ_0 vanishes at λ = 0 and λ = 1, and Δ_1 at λ = 1/2.

coverage: Read the whole paper: free.tex, profiles.tex, spectrum.tex, linear.tex, nonlinear.tex and main.tex; skimmed the certificates appendix and verifier. Checked by hand: the similarity-variable reduction; the imaginary-part/divergence identity (c_* = 6-2a); the formula V = b + r²/16 - w²/4; the Laguerre recurrences and the exact cone increment (Re λ + n - 5/2)|g_n|²; the tail-disk bound; and the backward-matrix column identity. Also checked the high-angular multiplier boundary/jump terms and the arc bound V_c > 0; the inner-problem barriers, comparison constants and contraction factor; the pressure-transport maximum argument and the V' identity; the positive-deformation bound w' ≥ .027; and the upper-energy (Pohozaev) identity for Re λ ≥ 4 with its integrability. Further checks: the interface conditions and symmetry-mode traces at R (time mode value -ib, derivative -Rb/2; translation; phase); the slow/fast integrability threshold for k ≥ 7; the free-flow norm rates, including the torus zero mode; the residual size L^{-2-a}; the Lyapunov–Perron sequence-norm bookkeeping; the parameter expansion C d' = (-θ+bβ, ζ, β); the Brouwer degree step; and the Gaussian full-support/H^k summability condition α > k+6. Numerical checks used mpmath hyperu and the exact verifier. I followed the escaping-parameter WKB/Airy lemmas and the compact-pencil convergence at the level of logic, without recomputing every constant.
main_claim: There are an odd p (sufficiently large), a k > 8, and a nonempty open set U ⊂ H^k(T^12) of data whose solutions to the defocusing equation i u_t + Δu = |u|^{p-1}u blow up in finite time T. The blowup is self-similar (type I), with (T-t)^{1/(p-1)}|u(t,x_*)| → c_0 > 0. As a corollary, Gaussian random data with ⟨n⟩^{-α} coefficients, for any α > k+6, blow up with positive probability.
sibling_notes: The family 371 board had no prior entries when I checked. The paper is self-contained: no companion-paper dependence. Cited blowup works (MRRS, CLGSS, Buck et al.) are context only.
